aboutGame.title: Yini i-Sminofu iTekisi?
paragraphs: I-Sminofu iTekisi yi-albhamu ka-2026 ye-Maskandi yomculi waseNingizimu Afrika uSminofu, ekhishwe ngo-Okthoba 16, 2026 nge-Sminofu / EMPIRE. Iphrojekthi enezingoma ezingu-17 ithatha cishe ihora nemizuzu eyisithupha, inezingoma ezingayedwa eziyishumi nambili kanye nokusebenzisana okuhlanu okuhlanganisa abaculi abane abayizivakashi.

Igama lisho itekisi ngesiZulu, futhi irekhodi lisebenzisa leso simo sansuku zonke njengohlaka lokunyakaza, ukuzabalaza, ingxoxo, nolwazi olwabiwe. Isisekelo sayo se-Maskandi sigxilisa isiginci esikhothwa ngeminwe nokuxoxa izindaba, kuyilapho ukulandelana kusuka kusingeniso esifushane nengoma yesihloko kuya engxenyeni yesibili egcwele izivakashi ngaphambi kokuvala nge-eMachobeni.

items.question: Yini i-Sminofu iTekisi?
items.answer: I-Sminofu iTekisi yi-albhamu ka-2026 ye-Maskandi yomculi waseNingizimu Afrika uSminofu. Ikhishwe ngo-Okthoba 16, 2026 nge-Sminofu / EMPIRE futhi iqukethe izingoma ezingu-17 cishe ihora elilodwa nemizuzu eyisithupha.

items.question: Zingaki izingoma eziku-Sminofu iTekisi?
items.answer: Kunezingoma ezingu-17, okuhlanganisa isingeniso esingu-1:28 i-Benilindele Bani, iculo elingu-4:06 elithi iTekisi, kanye nesiphetho esingu-3:43 i-eMachobeni. Izingoma eziyishumi nambili zomculi eyedwa kanti ezinhlanu zihlanganisa abaculi abayizivakashi.

items.question: Ubani ofaka ku-Sminofu iTekisi?
items.answer: U-Londeka Shangase, Ojakalasi, Njabulo Langa, kanye no-Zanefa Ngidi bavela ezingomeni ezinhlanu. UShangase uyena kuphela isivakashi esibonakale kabili, ku-Ngithunjiwe naku-Ngo December.

items.question: Sisho ukuthini igama elithi Sminofu iTekisi?
items.answer: Itekisi isho itekisi ngesiZulu. I-albhamu isebenzisa leso simo sansuku zonke ukuhlaka ukunyakaza, ukuzabalaza, ingxoxo, idumela, nolwazi olwabiwe.

items.question: Ngingasakaza kuphi i-Sminofu iTekisi?
items.answer: I-albhamu iyatholakala ezinsizeni zokusakaza ezisemthethweni ezihlanganisa i-Spotify ne-Apple Music. Sebenzisa imihlahlandlela yamapulatifomu kule sayithi ukuze uthole izixhumanisi eziqondile ze-albhamu namathiphu okulalela.
